summary: A slow morning, then the Nieman potluck from 2:15.

headlines.title: Iran escalates Gulf attacks as U.S. weighs next move
headlines.detail: At least 25 tankers hit near Hormuz in a week, per Al Jazeera; CBS reports the U.S. and Israel are weighing a new assault even as Trump talks of a permanent deal.

headlines.title: ICE arrests two boarding a flight at Sea-Tac
headlines.detail: Officers detained the passengers on a jet bridge before an Alaska Airlines departure.

headlines.title: U.S. and China to cut tariffs on ~$30B of goods
headlines.detail: The post-summit deal eases trade both ways; some analysts call the truce fragile. CNBC looks at Beijing's summit diplomacy.

headlines.title: Chinese Princeton Ph.D. student detained by ICE
headlines.detail: The student was held at Reagan National Airport after an academic conference.

headlines.title: Cursor weighs dropping Chinese AI models
headlines.detail: The SpaceX-owned coding tool told lawmakers it may phase out PRC-built open-weight models over geopolitical risk.

headlines.title: U.S. moves to block China's remote access to Nvidia chips
headlines.detail: A new Commerce rule targets access through overseas data centers; Bessent says H200 sales policy is unchanged.

headlines.title: Christie's caps auction week at $145.9M
headlines.detail: A $32.9M Basquiat led a softer sale, a day after Sotheby's set a Van Gogh record.

headlines.title: Lotus L. Kang wins the Sobey Art Award
headlines.detail: Canada's top contemporary art prize goes to the Korean-Canadian artist.
